name: flash_crowd
about: A legitimate rush. A game server's player count multiplies in a couple of seconds: the bank fills, the shaper holds it, and not one packet is objectively invalid. The assertion is that no rung that refuses a packet is ever reached, because nothing here can be confirmed by an exact key or by an invalid packet.
magnitudes: PARAMETERS, not measurements. This tree holds no traffic measurement to draw on: the numbers it does hold are per-packet costs (81 ns to 243 ns of pipeline). The steady state is set at 6 000 over-budget packets per second and the rush at eight times that, and the bank is taken from 40 to 300 loaded buckets of 1024 (DEFAULT_BANK_BUCKETS is read from lorica-common, never copied). Any of these may be re-baselined against a real capture without changing what the fixture asserts.

steps.note: steady state, three seconds of it
the rush arrives, one second in
second second: the bank is filling
twelve seconds of plateau. The shaper holds the level, so the bank stops rising and no link saturation is inferred. Still zero invalid packets, still no unified-list entry taking hits.
